brief.scope:
Security audit, PR #254 "Package C slice two: the codex launch
registers the acting coordination server", head 6213c35a on
lane/session-20260916-launcher, against origin/dev. Audit only, do not
edit. This wires coordination_mcp.py (coord_claim, coord_send,
coord_submit) into the codex launch path alongside agentscient_lane:
hunt argv/shell injection through the new mcp_servers.coordination.*
overrides, credentials or session ids leaking into the record or a
log, and any weakening of the sandbox a dispatched worker runs under
now that a second MCP server is wired in. One record, dispose findings
by db in the findings export with a contract citation.

coordination.unresolved: the dispatch named no assignment, so the core bound no participant for this worker to act as

caps.turns_note: codex offers no turn-cap flag (measured 2026-09-12: its --help names none); caps.turns is recorded, the wall cap governs

findings.claim: The privileged MCP process executes code loaded late from the worker snapshot. A Codex worker can alter its owned snapshot before its first coordination call, causing coordination.py to execute outside the worker sandbox with access to credentials and the live coordination store. This violates ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md:530-532 and docs/verified-couplings.md §The six obligations, item 5.
findings.reproduce: PYTHONPATH=ops/conductor/tools python3 -c 'import coordination_mcp,sys; assert "coordination" not in sys.modules; coordination_mcp._core(); assert "coordination" in sys.modules; print("coordination.py is loaded only when the configured server takes its first domain call")' && git grep -n -E 'sandbox = "workspace-write"|tool = Path\(snapshot\) / COORD_MCP_REL|import coordination' -- ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py ops/conductor/tools/coordination_mcp.py

findings.claim: Every assigned Codex launch supplies --config, but resolve_binding unconditionally refuses every configured call after validating the participant. Consequently coord_brief, coord_claim and coord_submit never reach the core, breaking the acting plane promised by ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md:1189-1203 and coordination-mcp-lever.md §2.3.

Relocation copies coordination-mcp.json byte-for-byte and rebases only its recorded path and server argv. The embedded worktree therefore continues pointing outside the relocated job. This contradicts ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md:1207-1208 and its requirement to rebind retained names under the current job root.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py").read_text(); f=s[s.index("def _relocate_coordination"):s.index("def _relocate_mcp")]; assert "prior.read_text" in f and "cfg.write_text" in f and "json.loads" not in f and "\"worktree\"" not in f; print("relocation copies coordination config byte-for-byte and never rebases its worktree")'

artifacts.verification: 14 targeted unit tests passed; git diff --check passed; worktree remained clean
artifacts.coverage: Reviewed argv/TOML, shell, SQL/template, secrets/session logging, path confinement, sandbox authority, vendor trust and supply-chain changes

envelope.note: reused: agentscient-lane brief/jobs/changes/findings interface, Graft navigation, dispatch and coordination contracts. No argv/shell/SQL/template injection, new secret leakage, or supply-chain loosening found. ../in contained no files. A live assigned Codex MCP launch and the live coordination store were not exercised; the store was not read. lane_findings refused because no record ids were configured. Graft saved approximately 1,634,367 tokens.
